brief: Wraps a sequence of integers held in the engine, so sums, extremes and counts are computed there without building a Ring list.
detail: Obtain one from stzCounter.CountingQ. The sequence stays in the engine: Sum, Min, Max, At and CountValue read it directly, and ToList copies it out when a Ring list is needed. Positions count from 1. The object owns the engine sequence and Release frees it; Disown hands the ownership away.
